findings.claim: Spec mandates verified identity for key management, but the auth.rs source has Option<axum::Extension<UserContext>> with an 'anonymous' fallback in create_key and list_keys, and revoke_key takes no user extension at all; the design lists auth.rs in scope but does not name the required code changes (require UserContext, remove the anonymous fallback, verify owner/tenant on revoke/list).
findings.evidence: extra_source for src/uar/api/auth.rs: create_key signature `user: Option<axum::Extension<UserContext>>` with `unwrap_or_else(|| "anonymous".to_string())`; list_keys has the same Option/unwrap pattern; revoke_key has no user parameter, only `Path(id)` and `state.api_key_service.revoke_key(&id).await`. The design lists 'src/uar/api/auth.rs' as in-scope but never enumerates the specific handler changes. Spec requirement 'Owner-authorized key management' says 'Key listing and revocation SHALL require verified identity', and scenario 'Cross-owner revoke' says 'B receives no key metadata and cannot revoke A's key' — the current code does not enforce either.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to the design's auth.rs scope: handlers must require Extension<UserContext> (not Option), drop the 'anonymous' fallback, and resolve each key's owner/tenant for list/revoke; reject mismatches with no metadata. Mirror the same rule in negative scenarios under tasks 1.3/1.4 so Plan has an explicit contract.

findings.claim: The 'Concrete persisted attenuation' scenario's WHEN describes only the granted case ('a key requests [user]') while the THEN bundles denial outcomes for distinct requests (reader, host-session or admin) that are not present in the WHEN, making the scenario harder to read and to fixture per request path.
findings.evidence: Spec text: 'WHEN verified caller roles are [user, reader], configured allowlist is [user], and a key requests [user] - THEN the stored roles and both resulting principal paths equal [user], retain verified subject/tenant, and contain no host or administrative provenance; requesting reader, host-session or admin is denied without creating a record.'
findings.suggested_fix: Split into one scenario for the granted [user] path, one for 'requesting a caller-held role outside the allowlist' (reader), and one for 'requesting a reserved role' (host-session or admin); each with its own WHEN/THEN so Plan can author a separate fixture per path.
